In the last 150 years, agricultural, residential, and industrial development have vastly reduced the extent of Garry oak ecosystems. 

.

 In California, a fungus associated with an oak epidemic that has spread hundreds of miles in 5 years may be an introduced exotic species.



.

 Oregon white oak (Quercus garryana)

.

 Surveyed trees extended from Whidbey Island, Washington, to Roseburg, Oregon, and ranged in age from 11 to over 300 yr.
